summary: In Tirisfal, the Forsaken strike at Scarlet Crusade forces threatening their borders. Executor Zygand sends champions after Captain Perrine and his garrison at a ruined tower southwest of Brill, using intelligence taken in Deathknell.

sections.title: Intelligence Put to Use
sections.body: Executor Arren recovered documents from the Scarlet Crusade in Deathknell, revealing troop movements across Tirisfal Glades. Rather than wait for the fanatics to attack newly fortified Brill, Executor Zygand uses the captured intelligence to strike their field commanders first.

sections.title: The Threat at the Ruined Tower
sections.body: Captain Perrine commands Scarlet Zealots and Missionaries from a ruined watchtower southwest of Brill. From there, the Crusade watches Forsaken movements and reaches farther into Tirisfal. Perrine's death matters to the defense of the Dark Lady's young kingdom.

faq.answer: Captain Perrine is a Scarlet Crusade officer at a ruined watchtower southwest of Brill, where he commands a detachment of Zealots and Missionaries pressing into Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where did the Forsaken get information on Captain Perrine?
faq.answer: Executor Arren recovered documents from the Crusade during the defense of Deathknell. They detail troop assignments and outpost locations, including Perrine's post.

faq.q: Why are Scarlet Missionaries and Zealots in Tirisfal?
aliases: why is scarlet crusade in tirisfal
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade sees all undead as abominations to be exterminated, whether they serve the Scourge or the Forsaken. Its missionaries and zealots push into Tirisfal to wage holy war and reclaim Lordaeron for the living.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into the campaign against the Crusade?
aliases: at war with the scarlet crusade chain
faq.answer: This is the second step in the Tirisfal campaign against the Crusade. Perrine's death breaks up a local scouting post before Executor Zygand escalates operations against larger encampments across the glades.

faq.q: Can this quest be done together with anything else nearby?
faq.answer: Yes. Proof of Demise pairs with it: Deathguard Burgess asks for Scarlet Insignia Rings taken from the same crusaders, as proof of loyalty to Varimathras and the Dark Lady.
Executor Zygand is the primary military commander stationed in Brill. He secures Tirisfal Glades and directs strategic offensives for Sylvanas Windrunner.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, eliminating the Scarlet Crusade is necessary for their survival. The zealots make no distinction between free-willed undead and the Scourge.
The Horde's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms depends on the Forsaken securing Tirisfal Glades against hostile human zealots.
